name: zoho-crm
description:
Governed Zoho CRM for small teams and AI agents. Eighteen commands across Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals and any custom module — every write held behind the airlock, every change sealed into a signed receipt.

WHO IT'S FOR: teams too small for a compliance function but regulated enough that 'who changed this client record, and who approved it' is a question they will eventually be asked — an eight-person insurance brokerage, a lending desk, a wealth-advisory practice. Also for anyone giving an AI agent write access to CRM and wanting a preview before it commits.

THE PROBLEM: CRM has no undo. A wrong filter on a mass update rewrites 400 client records at 6pm and there is no rollback, only a restore request and an awkward week. Zoho Flow and Zapier will both run that automation; neither can stop it, and neither leaves a tamper-evident record of who authorised it.

READS (no approval): verify_connection confirms auth and reports the org. describe_module returns every field including custom ones, so an agent never guesses at field names. search_records runs read-only COQL. list_records pages a module, get_record fetches one by id, list_users returns users and their ids.

WRITES (preview then approve): create_record and update_record work across any module, up to 100 per call. upsert_records inserts or updates in place against duplicate-check fields. delete_record moves to the recycle bin, recoverable 60 days. convert_lead turns a Lead into a Contact and Account. add_note writes reasoning back onto a record.

RELIABILITY: Zoho reports partial failure with HTTP 200, so a batch where 3 of 50 fail still looks successful. Every write returns succeeded, failed and per-record errors. Writes are never auto-retried after a server error, since Zoho has no idempotency key.

QUICK START: create a Self Client at api-console.zoho.com with scopes ZohoCRM.modules.ALL, ZohoCRM.settings.fields.READ, ZohoCRM.users.READ and ZohoCRM.coql.READ. Exchange the grant code for a refresh token, then save a vault entry named 'zoho' with refresh_token, client_id, client_secret, token_url and instance_url, matching your org's datacenter. Run verify_connection first. Secrets stay in the vault, never in process environment.

PLAN THEN APPLY: an approval binds to the inputs a human saw, not to the records they point at. Approve a diff over 80 records, someone edits nine while it sits there, and the write lands on state nobody reviewed. plan_update, plan_delete and plan_handover each snapshot the state they are about to change and fingerprint it; the matching apply re-reads, re-hashes, and refuses if anything moved. Scans page to completion, so a set is never half-reported. The update snapshot doubles as rollback data. plan_handover reports what a leaver owns across Leads, Deals, Contacts and Accounts, excluding closed deals unless asked; apply_handover re-scans, refuses on drift, and reassigns in one approved batch. The receipt is the handover record. contest:2026Q3

commands.title: Preflight: check every scope this module needs
commands.description: Probes each capability and reports which scopes are granted, which are missing, and exactly which commands a missing scope blocks. Run this first after configuring credentials.

commands.title: List the fields on a Zoho CRM module

module.description: Module API name, e.g. Leads, Contacts, Deals, or a custom module.

query.description: COQL SELECT statement. Anything other than SELECT is rejected.

commands.title: Page through records in a module

fields.description: Field api_names to return. Defaults to a core set per module.

commands.title: List org users and their ids

type.description: AllUsers, ActiveUsers, ActiveConfirmedUsers, AdminUsers, CurrentUser and so on. Defaults to ActiveConfirmedUsers.

commands.title: Plan a bulk update and fingerprint the current state

query.description: COQL SELECT picking the records to change. Zoho requires a WHERE clause.

changes.description: Field api_name to new value, applied to every matched record.

max_records.description: Refuse to plan beyond this many records. Max 100.

commands.title: Apply a plan, refusing if the records moved since it was made

module.description: Module API name, the same one that was planned.

query.description: The same COQL SELECT used for the plan.

changes.description: The same changes object used for the plan.

commands.description: Commit a plan made by zoho.plan_update. Re-runs the query, re-hashes the current state, and refuses the write if anything moved since the plan.

commands.title: Work out what a bulk delete would remove

query.description: COQL SELECT picking the records to delete. Zoho requires a WHERE clause.

commands.title: Commit a delete plan, refusing if the records moved
commands.description: Commit a plan from zoho.plan_delete. Re-runs the query, re-checks Modified_Time on every record, and refuses if anything changed since the plan. Records go to the recycle bin, recoverable for 60 days.

query.description: Same COQL SELECT used for the plan.

commands.title: Count everything one user owns, before moving any of it

from_user.description: Zoho user id of the person leaving. Use zoho.list_users.

modules.description: Modules to scan. Defaults to Leads, Deals, Contacts, Accounts.

closed_deals.description: 'skip' (default) leaves Closed Won and Closed Lost deals with the original owner. 'include' moves them too.

records.description: Up to 100 record objects keyed by field api_name.

records.description: Record objects, each of which MUST contain an 'id' plus the fields to change.

duplicate_check_fields.description: Field api_names used to detect an existing record, e.g. ["Email"].
